settings.command.label: Command
settings.command.description: The wireless-battery executable; it must support --json.
settings.interval.label: Check rate
settings.interval.description: Seconds between polls. Each poll briefly opens every supported receiver, so a longer interval uses less power.
settings.visibility.label: When nothing is connected
settings.visibility.description: Dynamic hides the widget while no device is found; static keeps it visible and shows a question mark.
settings.device_filters.label: Devices to show
settings.device_filters.description: List of filters; leave empty for all devices. Use a kind (mouse, headset, keyboard, gamepad, phone, other) or any part of a device name, key or connection. Multiple entries show multiple devices at once.
settings.mode.label: Bar content
settings.mode.description: Show every selected device, or only the one with the lowest charge.
panel.title: Power
panel.empty: No wireless devices with battery information found.
panel.missing: wireless-battery not found. Install it from {url} or set the command path in the plugin settings.
settings.grace.label: Keep last level
settings.grace.description: Seconds to keep the last known battery level while a device is asleep or temporarily missing. 0 disables it.
notify.missing.title: Wireless Battery CLI missing
notify.missing.body: Install 'wireless-battery' from {url}, or set the command path in the plugin settings.
